item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00308","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C19","C16","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C19","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C19 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both are appreciative letters about service on the same President's Advisory Committee on Government Organization; both credit the committee with promoting economy and efficiency and enumerate substantially overlapping organizational achievements, including creation of the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, the Federal Aviation Agency, and NASA. C16 has a similar report-acknowledgment and committee-praise structure, while C05 supplies the committee's foundational language, but neither matches the child's specific content as closely as C19.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The constructive advice of this Committee has played a large part in promoting economy and efficiency in the Executive Branch of the Government.","parent_excerpt":"Your work and concrete suggestions on government organization have been of substantial help ... in promoting economy and efficiency in government operations.","explanation":"Distinctive parallel attribution of economy-and-efficiency improvements to work on the same government-organization committee."},{"child_excerpt":"the Committee's contribution to ... the creation of three major agencies of government--the Department of Health, Education, and Welfare, the Federal Aviation Agency, and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration","parent_excerpt":"As a member of the Advisory Committee on Government Organization, you can take justifiable pride in having played an important role in the establishment of the Department of Health, Education and Welfare ... the Federal Aviation Agency, [and] the National Aeronautics and Space Agency","explanation":"The child condenses the parent's same committee-specific list of organizational achievements, retaining three of the same named agencies."},{"child_excerpt":"I again wish to express my appreciation to you, as Chairman, and to your colleagues on the Committee.","parent_excerpt":"In accepting your resignations from these two significant Advisory Committees, I want you to know that your counsel ... has been a source of steady satisfaction to me personally.","explanation":"Both close by personally thanking an individual and fellow committee members for advisory service."}]}
